title: An Inconclusive Vote Leaves Israelis Pondering an Uncertain Future
summary_full: A day after the election, supporters of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu were relieved he still had a chance to stay in power, while his opponents worried the mixed results could lead to a political stalemate.
